name: Translator
summary: Turns web pages, product copy and video captions into another language so they read as if written locally. Flags what a native speaker should check.

changelog.note: First release: translation canon, briefs, glossaries and translation memory, machine translation post-editing, locale formats, hreflang, subtitles, quality checks, EU AI Act labelling for translated text, and where to get certified translations in the US, UK and EU, with 30 checked sources.
